newsitem.title: USA: Chiron diabetic ulcer gel found safe.
newsitem.headline: Chiron diabetic ulcer gel found safe.

text.p: Chiron Corp said Monday that a U.S. Food and Drug Admininstration advisory panel has declared that its diabetic ulcer treatment is safe and effective.
The treatment, Regranex Gel 0.01 percent, is used for ulcers that occur on the lower limbs and feet.
A biologic licensing application for Regranex Gel was filed in December 1996. The product was developed jointly by the R.W. Johnson Pharmaceutical Research Institute and Chiron.
The active ingredient in Regranex Gel is becaplermin, the genetically engineered form of platelet-derived growth factor, a naturally occurring protein in the body that stimulates wound healing.

The data from a study presented to the FDA panel showed that the treatment, when applied once daily in combination with good wound care, significantly increased the incidence of complete healing by 43 percent when compared to placebo gel, Chiron said.
The gel also significantly decreased the time to complete healing by 32 percent, or six weeks, it said.
